violations.text: The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the storage shelving has an accumulation of rodent droppings. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026
The doors to both toilet rooms are not self-closing. Toilet room doors shall be self-closing to prevent potential contamination. New Violation. Correct By: 08/16/2026
